newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ten missing after Japan boat collides with ship.
newsitem.headline: Ten missing after Japan boat collides with ship.

text.p: Ten crew members were missing on Tuesday after a Japanese fishing vessel collided with a Panamanian-registered freighter near South Korea's Cheju Island on Monday evening, maritime officials said.

Eight Japanese and two Chinese were missing after the 144-tonne Choun Maru 18 collided with the 10,909-tonne Welsun in the East China Sea about 30 km (18 miles) southeast of Cheju Island, officials said.
Three patrol boats from Japan's Maritime Safety Agency had reached the scene of the collision and started the search for the missing crew along with patrol boats from South Korea, officials said.
